classification.all_map: Living on-map Road + ATV + Flying vehicles in current city.
classification.civilian: Excludes player, alien and ORG_MEGAPOL owners.
classification.events: Visible endpoint transitions; coarse sampling omits sub-frame journeys and is not complete throughput.
classification.mission_stopped: Current on-map mission roadStoppedTicks; can reset after a route or mission transition.
classification.parked: Living current-city vehicles with currentBuilding; includes the player.
classification.physical_episode_end_counters: Count only ended no-displacement episodes lasting at least 12000 ticks. Zero counters do not mean vehicles never moved.
classification.physical_fields: Only the fine-day private observer supplies these fields; blank CSV values for other runs mean unavailable, not zero.
classification.physical_peak_with_intent: Largest no-displacement duration for an episode with any driving intent at any point. It can include later intent loss or crash; it does not imply current driving intent or recovery.
classification.physical_stationarity: Consecutive six-tick ground-vehicle observations with position displacement <=0.00001. Retained handles distinguish end reasons. Intent history and crash state are separate from physical timing.
classification.police: All ORG_MEGAPOL on-map vehicles, including generated traffic.
classification.position_stationary: Mission-bearing ground vehicle with no net endpoint displacement accumulating 12000 ticks. Coarse samples cannot prove continuous immobility.

limitations: These individual traces and saved inputs do not provide a statistical significance test.
Identical saved RNG and state need not produce identical traces; prefix differences are explicitly retained.
Unchecked turbo proceeds through canTurbo=false frames and reports their count. Strict eligible-hour checks each frame. Rendered UI observations are separate.
Physical progress is measured at six-tick resolution with a small displacement tolerance; motion within a step is not continuously instrumented.
Density, initial-cohort movement, original-target completion, physical immobility and current-mission stopped time are distinct observations.
Private candidate screening uses object overrides against older frozen libraries. The recovery runs, including the partial strict stop, use the declared material head.
Results do not establish behavior for all custom saves, arbitrary future runtime durations or different material heads.

method.coarse: Actual updateTurbo at 43200 ticks/frame; sample positions at frame endpoints.
method.dispatch: Count Traffic batch at log messages independently of sampled entries.
method.fine: Actual update(6); sample positions each six ticks and publish census every 12000 ticks plus final endpoint.
method.means: Equal-weight checkpoints, including the fine-step irregular final checkpoint.
method.physical_observer: Additional private observer linked against the final central archives. It cannot reset physical immobility on mission or route changes; only physical movement, map exit or death ends an episode. Intent loss is a separate event.
method.resume: Load saved GameState and initState, with existing saved RNG. No startGame, reseeding, mission replacement or observer deletion.

private_candidate_screening.classification: Private screening only: a VehicleMission object override linked to frozen 685032b9 libraries and a private diagnostic observer. These are not upcoming committed-head runtime binaries.

limitations: Completion-hook lines can repeat and include cars outside the captured cohort; only unique captured vehicle/initial target pairs at the exact target tile count.
Physical movement >=2 tiles alone is not original-target completion.
RESULT dead=true is a dead state and does not by itself classify killed versus successful ambient retirement.
Eight executions share one save and saved RNG; duplicate traces are grouped, and these are not statistically independent trials.
Day census position stationarity is a five-minute endpoint metric, not continuous physical immobility.

Endpoint executable names were reused and execution-time binary hashes were not recorded for these endpoint receipts. Exact patch/probe source, save/RNG and raw receipts are retained; the verified census binary hash applies to the eight day census runs.

provenance.material_commit_attribution: Provided by integrator after central build; no git inspection performed by observation agent.

physical_observer.semantics: Observation-only physical timers; route/mission changes cannot reset physical duration. Intent loss logged separately. Retained handles distinguish exits/retirement/death. Save verifies unchanged clock and RNG.

rendered_ui_observation.limitation: Rendered observation reaches first alert at 12:20. Census counts are runtime data; screenshots do not show all city cars, and this is not a six-hour/day uninterrupted UI validation.
rendered_ui_observation.source_attribution: Integrator confirmed rebuilt app embeds material head.
rendered_ui_observation.state: Integrator left QA process open and paused. Data agent did not operate the process.
